gates.notes: Exact immutable upstream commit, full license/notice audit, and reproducible baseline run are not yet recorded.
Candidate sources are documented, but every asset intended for training still needs an individual license and training-permission decision.
The repository documents family-level splits; the local agent must verify the actual downloaded release, hashes, duplicate families, and split disjointness.
Existing samples are contextual full-line renders with logical target indices, not audited isolated target-glyph crops with verified HarfBuzz cluster mapping.
Schemas and templates exist, but a populated, provenance-reviewed paired prompt/measurement dataset has not been demonstrated.
The unified architecture is specified, but executable image encoder, prompt encoder, shared latent alignment, shared generator, and hybrid path have not been verified in this repository.
Required unit tests, forward/backward smoke tests, tiny-subset overfit, checkpoint round-trip, and resume tests have not been evidenced.
The local Windows preflight must be run on the actual machine; current GPU, VRAM, RAM, disk, backend compatibility, and runtime estimates are not established here.

data.existing_raster_dataset_description: Repository handoff documentation reports 7,904 contextual raster samples; the local agent must verify the release archive and actual contents.

resource_estimate.reason: Requires actual hardware and completed model/data implementation.
